connectOrCreate: @prisma/client: nested write operation, insert the row when the lookup misses
connect: @prisma/client: nested write operation, join an existing row
disconnect: @prisma/client: nested write operation, drop a joined row
set: @prisma/client: nested write operation, replace the joined rows
data: @prisma/client: write argument key holding the row values
$queryRaw: @prisma/client: method taking a query as a tagged template
$executeRaw: @prisma/client: method taking a statement as a tagged template
$queryRawUnsafe: @prisma/client: method taking a query as a string
$executeRawUnsafe: @prisma/client: method taking a statement as a string
